summary: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 and the Richard B. Russell National School Lunch Act to permanently ban child care providers from receiving federal financial assistance under these programs if they are found to have committed fraud.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to prevent fraud in the Child Care and Development Block Grant program and the Child and Adult Care Food Program, both of which are components of the social safety net. By debarring providers who commit fraud, the bill seeks to ensure that funds are used appropriately, which could be seen as reducing waste within existing welfare spending rather than expanding or reducing the overall scope of welfare. The focus is on the integrity of the programs, not their size.
